source.method: Exact F124-AC independently salted four-family generator bytecode, with only seed COHORTS rebound; protected source unavailable.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: Original accumulated causal evidence diluted by denominator depth-1 when scoring 10-12 hops although correct raw 16-bit path survives. Readout-only saturating evidence denominator at predeclared anchor may preserve long-chain positive classifications without extra cells.
Yggdrasil.model: Original AB gamma=.25 penalty=.25 frozen 7-active/9-retained inference. Return original raw T logit+continuity and compute original best=(raw/4+base[6])*(depth-1). Replace denominator ONLY for readout with min(depth-1,anchor), then apply original penalty .25*(1-ratio). No new state nor model weights.
Yggdrasil.fit_selection: Maximum exact paired FIT classification over all 48 new FIT pairs, tie prefer unchanged anchor=16 then smallest magnitude correction (larger anchor), all DEV untouched until anchor selection frozen.

Wingless.hypothesis: A source-blind four-bit raw-key fingerprint attached to one compact 12-bit packed state per node may discriminate hash collisions without adding path alternatives.
Wingless.payload: 16 bits max per node: existing 12-bit checksum channels plus exactly four bit XOR-folded nibble fingerprint of original 16-bit destination key. Preserve a single state per public node, original weights, score, and sorting. No encoded-edge memo, future lookahead memo or state capacity increase.
Wingless.fingerprint: xor of four raw 4-bit groups mod 16; separately source/destination, predeclared deterministic
Wingless.compatibility: Prior original packed affinity + alpha*(2*equal_fingerprint-1) for carried source matching and lookahead edge matching; alpha=0 must be exact same float score as original AA one-packed
Wingless.fit_selection: Select alpha maximizing 48 pairwise new FIT correct, tie min alpha including no-change control, then score separate new DEV once.
